Substation Technician- B has a 4-6 year continuous working knowledge of 525 kv and below substation equipment, apparatus, and wiring. This position requires work in confined spaces and in elevated work areas, and works with various pieces of construction equipment specific to the trade. A Substation Technician- B may work independently or with others, occasionally work long hours during emergency conditions. This position should be able to coach subordinates on the crew. This position works at various locations. The position may also be required to travel to another state depending on customer demands. Essential Functions Work safely while performing new construction, maintenance or repair, testing, adjusting and troubleshooting work of substation equipment/systems which includes, but is not limited to, work involving the following: Concrete Foundations, ground grids, and steel erection Buswork (High and Low Voltage) Airbreak / Hookstick Switches Control Cable Terminations (High / Low Voltage) Control Buildings Conduit and duck banks Capacitor bank installations 23kv- 230 kv Transformers, regulators and circuit breakers Circuit Switchers, motor-operated and manual switches Responsible for maintaining Company vehicles, test equipment and tools in good working conditions. Frequently works with energized high voltage systems requiring skill and care to protect the lives of themselves and others. Minimum Requirements Able to perform rigorous physical labor. Must be capable of climbing and working at heights up to 125 feet above ground. Must possess a Commercial Drivers’ License. Must supply own personal hand tools required by the company for this work. Must supply own safety toed work boots. Must be capable of lifting in excess of 50 lbs. Must be capable of working in confined spaces/areas. Must be able to work independently or with others. Operational experience of various types of heavy equipment: Bucket, derrick and boom trucks Backhoes, excavators and skid steer loaders Articulating Man-lifts Pressure Diggers Trenchers Track Crawler Loader/Backhoe Rough Terrain Telescopic Forklifts Willing to work over-time or long hours during emergency conditions and/or when requested. Schedules can change frequently and with short notice. 90% Travel Required Capable of following Company safety rules and policies. Must have knowledge of construction standard practices, techniques, quality requirements, applicable codes and standards. Must be capable of working in close proximity of energized substation equipment. Must be capable of interpreting substation structural drawings (i.e. elevations, plan views, section views, grounding details, and foundation plans) and communicate with customers and subordinates. Capable of accurately appraising technical situations. Must be able to coach subordinates on the crew. Must be able to develop and interpret a material list. Must be able to trace out phasing in a substation and verify to the three line diagrams. Retained knowledge in all aspects of substation systems. Ability to establish grade, elevations, and layout of foundations and cable trough in new and existing stations. Grade and finish concrete slabs and foundations. Capable of performing routine carpentry work on building wood concrete forms to meet size and shape of concrete to be placed. Willing to work over-time when requested. Willing to work outside of the normal work schedule including weekends, holidays, and overtime as required for the position. Physical Demands The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to stand; walk; use hands to fingers, handle to feel; and reach with hands and arms. Work Environment While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. The employee is occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at construction job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. This position is performed in outside weather conditions. We work with hundreds of utility clients across the country, and we continuously expand our offerings to supply our customers with the ideas, technology, experience, manpower and equipment to perform any job. “Essential” is the one word that sums up who we are, the work we do and what our people mean to us. Each of our employees plays a critical role in ensuring that infrastructure systems are up and running when people and businesses need them. Pike is a family-oriented workplace with a strong culture of safety, collaboration, innovation and exceptional customer service. Our workforce consists of more than 65,000 professionals, present in more than 40 countries across the five continents, all contributing to our mission to design a better planet. Are you a passionate individual who wants to make a difference, promote sustainable development, and find solutions to the biggest global challenges, including climate change, overpopulation, and water scarcity? Come and join us in building the infrastructure our planet needs to achieve a sustainable future. Benefits High profile Rail project, Melbourne Metropolitan Salary packaging and novated vehicle leasing options Mentoring and leadership development pathways Company share options Discounted private health memberships Project Info Acciona delivers major rail upgrades through the Southern Program Alliance, removing level crossings and improving safety and reliability across Melbourne's rail network. The Alliance's scope has expanded from the Frankston line to Melbourne's inner west, removing crossings at Newport and Spotswood and realigning freight and passenger lines through Sunshine. About Opportunity We are seeking an experienced Senior Planner to join the Southern Program Alliance and support the delivery of one of Victoria's most significant rail programs. Reporting to the Project Manager, you will maintain the integrity, accuracy and timeliness of the project schedule, with a focus on the freight works package within the Sunshine realignment. You will work closely with Design, Contracts, Cost Planning and Construction teams, and use your expertise in Primavera P6 to keep the Integrated Master Schedule aligned with the overall program timeline. This role offers the chance to influence how a complex, multidisciplinary rail project is delivered and to work alongside experienced planning and construction professionals on a program that will reshape one of Melbourne's busiest rail corridors. Key accountabilities for the position will be: Develop and maintain the Integrated Master Schedule for freight works Apply critical path analysis to identify risks and dependencies Coordinate with design, construction and systems teams on interfaces Track progress against baseline schedules using Primavera P6 Prepare EVM reporting and schedule variance forecasts Identify schedule risks and maintain risk adjusted contingency plans Present schedule insights at program alliance meetings Qualification and Competencies: Tertiary qualification in Engineering, Construction Management or related field Extensive experience in planning or scheduling on major infrastructure projects Expert user of Primavera P6, with working knowledge of MS Project Rail experience highly desirable but NOT essential Strong understanding of critical path analysis and earned value management Ability to achieve a successful Pre-Employment Medical and National Crime Check Desired Skills and Experience Senior Planner, Inner west location. P6 experience. Extensive experience in planning or scheduling on major infrastructure projects

review_candidates.title: Senior Performance Acquisition Lead - Cash Offer
review_candidates.description: iSpeedToLead is looking for a senior, hands-on acquisition leader to grow our Cash Offer brand and attract US homeowners who want to sell their property. You will own paid acquisition as one connected system — channels, budgets, messaging, creatives, landing pages and measurement. The goal is profitable growth in qualified seller leads, not cheaper clicks. What You’ll Own Personally launch, manage and scale Google and Meta; develop TikTok; evaluate X and ChatGPT Ads where you can make a credible business case. Allocate budget across channels, markets and audiences based on lead quality and commercial outcomes. Turn seller insights into offers, creative briefs and landing-page tests together with our creative and development partners. Connect campaign data to CRM and downstream outcomes (qualified leads, accepted and published leads, sales, refunds, realized revenue) and keep improving attribution. Build a clear testing and reporting rhythm, and drive solutions independently. What we’re looking for Proven hands-on ownership of both Google and Meta, including multi-channel budget decisions — not agency oversight. Successful US lead-generation experience. Motivated-seller and homeowner lead generation is especially relevant; home services, mortgage, insurance or lead marketplaces are also welcome. Evidence of improving lead quality and business economics beyond platform CPL and ROAS. Experience improving creative, landing pages and conversion flows with designers and developers, validated through tracking and CRM data. Fast learning and independent execution, comfortable with AI and automation, and aware of platform policy and privacy constraints. Clear professional English and genuine end-to-end ownership. TikTok experience is a strong advantage. How Success Is Measured More qualified, commercially valuable seller leads at a sustainable acquisition cost, with positive contribution after acquisition costs and downstream quality and refund effects. We look at the combined result across channels, not a single platform metric. Your first 30 days Establish a performance baseline and agree targets. Prioritize and ship campaign, creative and funnel improvements. Show which channel and market combinations deserve investment, with an evidence-backed scaling plan. How to start the conversation This is a hands-on lead role, not a strategy-only position. Please send your CV or LinkedIn profile plus 1–2 relevant cases: your personal role, the channels, spend and timeframe, the lead-quality and commercial results, and one decision that improved the outcome (anonymized cases are welcome). Also share your availability and compensation expectations.
